boxes.title: Capitals & rulers: added detail
items: Nagabhata I: first capital ==**Ujjain**== (⚠ other notes: **Bhinmal** first)
Vatsaraja: start of the **tripartite struggle**; ⚠ some notes: he made Kannauj capital
Nagabhata II lost to Govinda III in **Bundelkhand** campaign

boxes.title: Mihira Bhoja: more
items: Early defeats by Palas, Rashtrakutas, **Kalachuris**, then comeback
Checked by ==**Sankaravarman** of Kashmir==, **Krishna II**, Pala **Devapala**
Suleman identified Bhoja as ruler; Al-Masudi called the kingdom **Al-Juzr**; Sulaiman praised army, wealth, security

boxes.title: Rajashekhara & decline: more
items: Rajashekhara also patronised by ==**Mahipala I**==; Karpuramanjari = **Prakrit** play
Breakaway also **Chaulukyas**; temple style peaked at **Khajuraho** (UNESCO)
